views.definition:
SELECT j.id,
    j.nama,
    j.kategori,
    j.panduan,
    h.harga_per_kg,
    h.berlaku_mulai
   FROM (jenis_sampah j
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT harga_sampah.harga_per_kg,
            harga_sampah.berlaku_mulai
           FROM harga_sampah
          WHERE ((harga_sampah.jenis_sampah_id = j.id) AND (harga_sampah.berlaku_mulai <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta'::text))::date))
          ORDER BY harga_sampah.berlaku_mulai DESC
         LIMIT 1) h ON (true));

WITH kalender AS (
         SELECT ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta'::text))::date AS hari_ini
        )
 SELECT k.hari_ini,
    x.nilai_hari_ini_rp,
    x.berat_hari_ini_kg,
    x.transaksi_hari_ini,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM akun
          WHERE ((akun.peran = 'nasabah'::text) AND akun.aktif)) AS nasabah_aktif,
    ( SELECT count(DISTINCT jadwal_layanan.tanggal) AS count
           FROM jadwal_layanan
          WHERE (jadwal_layanan.tersedia AND (jadwal_layanan.tanggal >= (date_trunc('week'::text, (k.hari_ini)::timestamp without time zone))::date) AND (jadwal_layanan.tanggal < ((date_trunc('week'::text, (k.hari_ini)::timestamp without time zone))::date + 7)))) AS hari_tersedia_minggu_ini
   FROM (kalender k
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(v_riwayat_setoran.nilai_setoran_rp), (0)::numeric) AS nilai_hari_ini_rp,
            COALESCE(sum(v_riwayat_setoran.berat_kg), (0)::numeric) AS berat_hari_ini_kg,
            count(*) AS transaksi_hari_ini
           FROM v_riwayat_setoran
          WHERE (v_riwayat_setoran.tanggal_setoran = k.hari_ini)) x);

SELECT s.id AS setoran_id,
    ((('TRX-'::text || to_char((s.tanggal_setoran)::timestamp with time zone, 'DDMMYY'::text)) || '-'::text) || lpad((s.id)::text, GREATEST(3, length((s.id)::text)), '0'::text)) AS kode_setoran,
    s.tanggal_setoran,
    s.dicatat_pada,
    s.nasabah_id,
    n.kode_akun AS kode_nasabah,
    n.nama AS nama_nasabah,
    s.pengelola_id,
    p.nama AS nama_pengelola,
    string_agg(j.nama, ', '::text ORDER BY j.nama) AS jenis_sampah,
    sum(d.berat_kg) AS berat_kg,
    sum(d.subtotal_rp) AS nilai_setoran_rp,
    'Terverifikasi'::text AS status
   FROM ((((setoran s
     JOIN akun n ON ((n.id = s.nasabah_id)))
     JOIN akun p ON ((p.id = s.pengelola_id)))
     JOIN detail_setoran d ON ((d.setoran_id = s.id)))
     JOIN jenis_sampah j ON ((j.id = d.jenis_sampah_id)))
  GROUP BY s.id, n.id, p.id;

SELECT n.id AS nasabah_id,
    n.kode_akun AS kode_nasabah,
    n.nama,
    COALESCE(sum(r.nilai_setoran_rp), (0)::numeric) AS saldo_rp,
    COALESCE(sum(r.berat_kg), (0)::numeric) AS total_kg,
    COALESCE(sum(r.berat_kg) FILTER (WHERE (EXTRACT(year FROM r.tanggal_setoran) = EXTRACT(year FROM (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta'::text)))), (0)::numeric) AS kg_tahun_ini
   FROM (akun n
     LEFT JOIN v_riwayat_setoran r ON ((r.nasabah_id = n.id)))
  WHERE (n.peran = 'nasabah'::text)
  GROUP BY n.id;
